lines.text: Auger, TOPSIDE. You are cleared to descend. Keep the chatter on channel two.
Auger, this is TOPSIDE. Your manifest is approved. Do not open the sealed crates.
Copy your first bite, Auger. Mind the drill room temperature. We have lost crews to impatience.
TOPSIDE reads a fire aboard. Put it out, Auger. The paperwork for a fire is worse than the fire.
Water in the lower deck. Pumps first, questions later.
Auger, your hull telemetry is ugly. Patch what you can. We are not sending anyone.
Unregistered rig on your scope. They are not friends. They are not ours, either.
Good work. Do not salvage their logs. Send them up unread.
We copy the loss. Log it and keep moving, Auger.
Seismic says something large is moving behind you. Do not stop to look.
That is the gate, Auger. Nobody has come back up through it. Nobody has tried.
